svg.title: Ziganya system data flow between all services
svg.desc: Structural diagram showing how the React Native mobile app and Next.js admin dashboard communicate through CloudFront and API Gateway to the NestJS microservices, which read and write to PostgreSQL, Redis, S3, and SQS, with external integrations to Twilio, M-Pesa, Stripe, FCM, and the AI API.

svg.text: All services inside a private AWS VPC · CloudWatch monitors every layer · Sentry catches errors in real time
